category: GraphRAG, Hybrid Knowledge Graphs & Agentic Retrieval Engines

repositories.name: RAGFlow
repositories.primary_strength: Deep document layout recognition (DeepDoc) fused with hybrid BM25 + vector + GraphRAG retrieval
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Full Elasticsearch/Infinity + MySQL + MinIO Docker stack uses ~4.2GB baseline RAM

repositories.name: LlamaIndex
repositories.primary_strength: 300+ LlamaHub data connectors, event-driven Workflows, and PropertyGraphIndex for structured RAG
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Rapid minor-version API evolution across llama-index-core and integration sub-packages

repositories.name: LightRAG
repositories.primary_strength: Dual-level (low/high) entity-relation graph retrieval that cuts GraphRAG indexing tokens by 90.9% and query API calls to 1
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Requires an entity-extraction LLM pass during initial document ingestion

repositories.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
repositories.primary_strength: Hierarchical Leiden community summaries for global sensemaking across massive private corpora
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Heavy Leiden community indexing amplifies ingestion token spend 11x vs LightRAG and requires full rebuilds on updates

repositories.name: Haystack
repositories.primary_strength: Explicit DAG pipeline orchestration with serializable YAML components, hybrid rankers, and production tracing
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Fewer pre-built no-code UI templates than RAGFlow

repositories.name: Chonkie
repositories.primary_strength: Zero-bloat semantic, token, and recursive RAG chunking library (33x faster and 95% smaller install than heavy frameworks)
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Focused purely on high-speed chunking; pairs with Qdrant/LanceDB for retrieval
